integrity: Backward-equation proof and exact moment inequalities supplied; numerical finite-state checks are corroborative, not substitutes for the proof. Possible unindexed earlier equivalence remains unexcluded.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns exactly two instantaneous velocity states, integrable spatial reversal intensities of fixed integral, equiprobable initial directions, and two perfectly absorbing endpoints. Rate caps and other escape observables are not classified; sharp bounds are not attained within L1.
title: Optimal spatial reversal budgets for escape of a persistent walker
